QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Hint from the Mask
QuestInfo.1: Cantor says he's not a princess. At least, you THINK he's a he.\r\nHe gave you a vase of water to pour on #bBernhardt#k. Sure, why not?
QuestInfo.2: You poured water all over Bernhardt, just like Cantor asked. To help Bernhardt dry off, Ian handed him a familiar handkerchief...

no.0: What's the matter, you allergic to fun? A little water won't melt him. Probably.
